other_failure_modes.name: Target encoding leakage via un-nested KFold alignment
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is performed using KFold splits outside the main model cross-validation loop, but uses the exact same random state (42). other_failure_modes.description: Categorical variables are label-encoded into arbitrary integers and then fed directly into the neural network's linear layers after standard scaling. other_failure_modes.name: Imputation before cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: A SimpleImputer is fit on the entire training dataset before the cross-validation loop. This leaks the missing-value statistics of the validation folds into the training folds during the neural network's cross-validation.

summary: The solution implements a strong, well-structured ensemble pipeline with extensive feature engineering, KFold cross-validation, and Ridge stacking. However, it contains a few subtle flaws: target encoding is performed outside the CV loop using the same random seed (causing target leakage), imputation is fit globally on the train set before CV, and categorical features are fed as scaled integers to the neural network.
